create_replica_dataset: create a ReplicaDataset to load RGBD frames and camera poses from a Replica scene directory
create_scannet_dataset: create a ScanNetDataset to load RGBD frames and camera poses from a ScanNet scene directory
create_realsense_franka_dataset: create a RealsenseFrankaOffline dataset to load RGBD frames and end-effector poses from a Franka tabletop dataset
create_scene_cache: create a SceneCache to preload all RGBD frames and poses into memory for fast evaluation access
create_ros_subscriber: create a ROSSubscriber dataset to consume live RGBD frames and poses from a ROS node
